model_system: 2D kagome-lattice nearest-neighbor Heisenberg antiferromagnet with direct/inverse triangular order, plus a driven FM/noncollinear-AFM bilayer interface solved via linearized LLG

key_params.continuum_gradient_tensor: Gamma_ab^{alpha beta} = eta (sqrt(3)/4) J S^2 (delta_{a alpha} delta_{b beta} + delta_{a beta} delta_{b alpha}) for alpha,beta in {x,y}; zero if alpha=z or beta=z
key_params.order_parameter_cases: direct triangular: eta=1; inverse triangular: eta=1 for alpha=beta and -1 for alpha!=beta
key_params.spin_current_formula: J^a = -(1/2) Gamma_ab^{alpha beta} n_alpha x partial_b n_beta
key_params.spin_density_formula: J^0 = (rho/2) sum_alpha n_alpha x partial_t n_alpha = rho Omega
key_params.spin_wave_ansatz: n_alpha(r,t)=n_alpha^0 + Re[theta exp(i(k·r-omega t))] x n_alpha^0
key_params.boundary_problem: FM layer driven by external AC magnetic field on a few leftmost layers; harmonic excitations propagated through FM/AFM interface by linearized LLG

headline_claim: A static twist in the noncollinear kagome AFM gives a purely transverse Noether spin current J^y = ±(sqrt(3)/8) J S^2 (partial_x phi) n_y, demonstrating a Hall-like spin current response.
replication_difficulty: medium-high + continuum formulas are explicit, but reproducing the bilayer numerics needs linearized LLG interface implementation and boundary-condition details from the full paper/end matter
